C0891.title: China Telecom Insider Sold Over 200 Million Customer Records
C0891.summary: From 2013 to September 2016, Chen Mouyi illegally obtained mobile phone number information differentiated by industry and region from China Telecom's 114 Best Tone database and supplied it to Chen Moujia, who sold it online across 22 provinces and cities, illegally profiting over 20 million yuan and involving more than 200 million pieces of citizen personal information. The Zhejiang Provincial People's Procuratorate supervised the case as a particularly serious crime of infringing citizen personal information and pursued accomplices and downstream buyers.
